# truenas_cronjob (Resource)

Manages a cron job (cronjob) on TrueNAS: a scheduled command executed by the system crontab as a given user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_cronjob" "nightly_cleanup" {
  command     = "/usr/local/bin/cleanup.sh"
  user        = "root"
  description = "Nightly tmp cleanup"

  schedule = {
    minute = "30"
    hour   = "2"
    dom    = "*"
    month  = "*"
    dow    = "*"
  }

  enabled = true
  stdout  = true
  stderr  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Shell command or script to execute.
- `user` (String) System user account to run the command as.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what this cron job does. Defaults to an empty string.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the cron job is active and will be executed. Defaults to true.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Cron schedule for when the job runs. Defaults to every day at 00:00. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `stderr` (Boolean) Whether to IGNORE standard error: if false, standard error is included in the notification email. Defaults to false.
- `stdout` (Boolean) Whether to IGNORE standard output: if false, standard output is included in the notification email. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the cron job.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `dom` (String) Day of month.
- `dow` (String) Day of week (cron format, 7=Sunday).
- `hour` (String) Cron hour.
- `minute` (String) Cron minute (e.g. "00", "*/15").
- `month` (String) Month.
